title: SpaceX won’t remove all of xAI’s unpermitted turbines for another year
summary: SpaceX said on Thursday that it will remove the unpermitted turbines powering its xAI data centers near Memphis as it transitions to a permanent, 1.2 gigawatt natural gas power plant.
